positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I currently lead projects focused on building tools and developer experiences for Netflix Games and its partner studios. These projects span the full stack, including React/TypeScript web clients and Electron desktop clients, CLI tooling, Java backend services, GraphQL APIs, and gRPC. Defined the technical strategy, architecture, and visual design for our engine plugins, with an emphasis on feature parity and maximizing shared platform code. I also use agentic development workflows with Claude via Cursor throughout development, including discovery, scoping, prototyping, implementation, and validation.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
LoL / TFT Tech Foundations - Build, Test, Ship

- Technical lead for LoL and TFT’s deployment tooling, empowering teams of engineers and artists to ship thousands of changes to millions of players in over twenty regions every week. Responsible for high level design and architecture of these tools, ensuring multi-game flexibility, reliability, and self service. Participate in on-call rotations in support of our deployment infrastructure.
- Technical lead for LoL / TFT’s Middle East + North Africa Shard infrastructure buildout.
- Technical lead for Modular Environment Patchlines, enabling parallel work streams on shared infrastructure. Significantly accelerated studio experimentation and development efforts, and continues to save ~$500k+ per year in infrastructure and human maintenance costs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
League of Legends - Build, Test, Ship

- Project lead for LoL internal environment rebuild and modernization. Led a team of software and system engineers to build 23 modern AWS-based LoL environments to re-enable studio operations after internal systems breach. Environments save ~$300k per year vs. their predecessors due to streamlined infrastructure and lower maintenance cost. Presented experience during a company-wide campfire regarding the incident.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack software engineer working on TripAdvisor Experiences.
- Using Java, React, and GraphQL, design, create, and maintain new features for our travelers within Experiences.
- Took ownership of an initiative to surface product info from an ML model. This initiative involved writing and iterating on a design proposal, and resulted in an estimated $8MM+ annualized revenue.
- Built a module for tracking user activity on product shelves within Experiences that will be used to train ML models. Worked with downstream consumers to build a generic and adaptable event schema, and infrastructure capable of scaling to 30MM events per day.
- Built a Covid-19 response banner, encouraging travelers to leave reviews and post pictures.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Full stack developer working on Laserfiche Cloud’s Access Control System:
- Involved in the design and implementation of functionality ranging from subscription billing, asset management, account management, user authentication, inter-application communications, and internal utilities.
- Served as primary contact for front-end code, and usability related concerns for cloud and on premises access control teams, providing code inspection, guidance, and best practices to other developers.
- Worked with quality assurance, product ownership, user experience, and customer success management to deliver highly impactful and highly usable features in a fast-paced, agile environment.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern, Mobile
positions.description: - Migrated an advanced template selection form from Sencha Touch to Android and iOS using a custom MvvmCross MvxRecyclerView (Android) and UICollectionView (iOS).
